headline: Product Launch and Client Implementation Specialist | HealthTech SaaS | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR company, running client implementations and feature rollouts across close to 200 practices. I plan and coordinate work between clients, product and delivery teams, turn client feedback into requirements that get built, and train clinicians on what ships. I also took my own AI content SaaS from discovery to launch and now run it with paying pilot clients, so I know both sides of a launch.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and go-live.
Coordinated clients, clinicians and internal product teams through each rollout, keeping plans, hand-offs and go-live dates on track.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on new workflows and features.
Collected feedback from clients, grouped recurring pain points into PRDs and feature requests, and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: project planning, cross-functional coordination, client onboarding, early adopter feedback, go-live support, PRDs
demos, training, check-ins, feedback sessions with healthcare providers, stakeholder communication
AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), React, GitHub, n8n; emergency, ICU and ambulatory clinical workflows
thesis_html: A launch works when clinicians actually adopt it. I have run that from both sides.
why_fit: End-to-end implementations, from discovery to go-live, with clinicians as the users.
Recurring client pain points became feature requests, and many were built.
Took an AI SaaS from discovery to launch and iterate on pilot client feedback.
